name: Martin I. Aarons
tagline: Top rated Employment Litigation attorney in Calabasas, California
education: University of San Diego School of Law
about: Martin I. Aarons is an attorney and the principal of The Aarons Law Firm, based in Calabasas, California, where he focuses his practice on labor and employment law. Mr. Aarons represents clients from Encino and the surrounding areas such as Beverly Hills, Burbank, Culver City, Glendale, Los Angeles and Santa Monica with civil litigation matters, including illegal workplace discrimination, sexual harassment and wrongful termination. He has more than 10 years of experience in employment law litigation.

Mr. Aarons received a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University and obtained his law degree from the University of San Diego School of Law. He is admitted to practice in all California state courts and the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California.

Professional associations that Mr. Aarons belongs to include the Los Angeles County Bar Association, the San Fernando Valley Bar Association, The State Bar of California, the California Employment Lawyers Association and the Consumer Attorneys of California. He is also a member of the Legal Eagles for Truth, Justice & the American Way, an affiliate of the National Employment Lawyers Association.

A member of the board of governors for the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles, Mr. Aarons has received special honors from the organization on several occasions. He also serves as chair of the organization's group for new lawyers.

Enthusiastic about sharing his legal knowledge with others, Mr. Aarons enjoys lecturing and speaking at various conferences and seminars, including a convention for the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles. He is a co-chair for the organization's 2015 convention.
